hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Custom 1:1 ETH/phiETH swap hook that implements its own curve in beforeSwap: takes the input token from PoolManager, converts it via phiEth.deposit/withdraw, and settles the output directly. Returns a BeforeSwapDelta to no-op the concentrated liquidity swap. Blocks all direct liquidity addition and enforces zero-fee ETH/phiETH pools only.
